html: The pages that name the specification version say v0.2 draft: the home page, Inside the standard, How it works, the entity map, Contribute, the status lines of the registry and question bank indexes, and llms.txt. The entity map is described as drawn for v0.1 and unchanged in v0.2, since v0.2 adds no entity and removes none, and its two reserved names read "no fields yet" rather than "no fields in v0.1"; both labellings are generated from the drawing's source, and a check refuses a page whose spliced drawing differs from fresh generation. Corrected: the entity-map legends, How it works and the standard page said individual records are never employer-visible and the aggregate report is the only output that leaves, which contradicted the specification's expressly classified individual-employer fields; they now say that aggregate-only values reach an employer through a report satisfying the privacy profile, that individual instrument results are never employer-visible, and that only the expressly classified individual-employer fields may be disclosed at individual grain under the independent-legal-basis condition. The v0.1 release archive is served byte for byte as published, and a check refuses a substitute. The README names both drafts.
